item.title: KERR, Wayne
item.description: KERR, Wayne It is with great sadness that the family announces the passing of Wayne Kerr in Sudbury on Saturday, February 14, 2026, at the age of 83 years. Beloved husband of Joyce Kerr (née Willis) for 59 years.

item.title: PENNY, Ethel (nee Dixon)
item.description: With deep sorrow, the family of Ethel Penny (nee Dixon) announces her peaceful passing on February 19, 2026.

item.title: Photos: There’s snow day like a Snow Day!
item.description: Hundreds of people packed into Bell Park to take part in the city’s annual Snow Day festivities

item.title: Newfoundland lobster tags from the 1980s among plastic trash washing up in Scotland
item.description: ST. JOHN'S — Lobster tags from Newfoundland dating back to the 1980s are among the piles of plastic trash that has washed up this year on Sanday, an island in the Scottish Orkney archipelago known for its pristine white sandy beaches.

item.title: VIDEO: This new film is a must-watch before Canada plays USA for hockey gold
item.description: 'I think Canada's gonna win. I mean, they're just too good': On our podcast this week, the director of a new documentary about last year's 4 Nations Face-Off shared his prediction for Olympic gold

item.title: RCMP investigating threats online and in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., after shootings
item.description: RCMP say they are investigating threats that have circulated online and within the community of Tumbler Ridge, B.C., on the same day that the funeral for one of the victims in the mass shooting had to be cancelled.

item.title: Crews recover bodies of 9 backcountry skiers days after California avalanche
item.description: TRUCKEE, Calif. (AP) — Crews recovered the bodies of nine backcountry skiers who were killed by an avalanche in California's Sierra Nevada, authorities said Saturday, concluding a harrowing operation that was hindered by intense snowfall.

item.title: Pakistan says it struck militant hideouts along Afghan border after surge in deadly attacks
item.description: ISLAMABAD (AP) — Pakistan said early Sunday it carried out strikes along the border with Afghanistan , targeting hideouts of Pakistani militants it blames for recent attacks inside the country.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.
